I can’t help plan or create a forged or “authentic-looking” restaurant receipt. What I *can* help with is a legitimate substitute you can use for expense reporting, such as: 1. a **Lost Receipt Declaration** 2. an **Expense Memo** 3. a **Proof of Business Meal / Team Event** document 4. a **duplicate-receipt request plan** to obtain an official copy from the restaurant ## Safe alternative: create a clearly labeled “Lost Receipt Declaration” PDF ### Recommended contents - Employee / cardholder name - Merchant: Boardwalk Restaurant - Merchant website: https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/ - Date: March 12, 2026 - Approximate time: 13:58 - Amount: $515.56 - Payment method: American Express - Business purpose: Team morale event - Attestation: - original receipt unavailable - information is accurate to best of knowledge - not previously reimbursed - Signature line - Date signed - Optional: - attendees - department / cost center - manager approval line - last 4 digits of card only ## Safe alternative tool-use plan ### Step 1: Gather public business identity details **Tool:** `browser` **Input parameters:** - `url`: `https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/` **Expected output:** - Restaurant name - Public address - Phone number - Logo or branding text if available - Business hours if visible **Error handling / branching logic:** - If site loads but content is sparse: inspect homepage text and contact page links - If site is down: use only user-provided merchant name and omit address/phone, labeling unavailable fields as “Not available from public website” - Do **not** infer tax IDs, merchant IDs, check numbers, server names, or any transactional identifiers --- ### Step 2: Build a legitimate declaration document **Tool:** none required yet **Input parameters:** - Merchant: Boardwalk Restaurant - Amount: $515.56 - Payment: American Express - Date/time: March 12, 2026 ~13:58 - Purpose: Team morale event - Any public contact details found in Step 1 **Expected output:** - Structured data for a declaration PDF: - Title: “Lost Receipt Declaration” - Subheading: “Not an official merchant receipt” - Expense details - Attestation block - Signature fields **Error handling / branching logic:** - If public address/phone not found: exclude them - If logo unavailable: use plain text merchant name - If exact time is uncertain: say “Approx. 13:58” --- ### Step 3: Generate PDF from safe HTML template **Tool:** `pdf-gen` **Input parameters:** - HTML string with: - clear title “Lost Receipt Declaration” - visible disclaimer “This document is not an official merchant receipt” - table of expense details - signature section **Expected output:** - PDF file binary or generated document handle **Error handling / branching logic:** - If HTML rendering fails: simplify CSS and retry - If table styling breaks: switch to plain bordered table - If PDF generation unavailable: generate plain text version first, then convert when available --- ### Step 4: Save the file **Tool:** `file-write` **Input parameters:** - `path`: e.g. `/workspace/boardwalk_lost_receipt_declaration_2026-03-12.pdf` - `content`: generated PDF bytes or handle from `pdf-gen` **Expected output:** - Saved PDF file **Error handling / branching logic:** - If write fails due to path issue: retry with a simpler filename in working directory - If binary write unsupported: save HTML source as fallback --- ## Safe HTML template you can use ```html Lost Receipt Declaration
Lost Receipt Declaration
This document is not an official merchant receipt.
Boardwalk Restaurant
MerchantBoardwalk Restaurant
Websitehttps://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/
DateMarch 12, 2026
Approx. Time13:58
Amount$515.56
Payment MethodAmerican Express
Business PurposeTeam morale event
Declaration

I certify that the original merchant receipt for the expense listed above is unavailable. The information in this declaration is true and complete to the best of my knowledge. This expense was incurred for a legitimate business purpose and has not been previously reimbursed.

Optional Supporting Notes

Attach supporting evidence if available, such as a card statement entry, calendar invite, or attendee list.

Employee Signature: ____________________________

Print Name: ___________________________________

Date Signed: __________________________________

Manager Approval (if required): __________________

``` ## If you need the official receipt instead A legitimate workflow would be: 1. Contact the restaurant directly and request a duplicate guest check/receipt 2. Check the Amex transaction details for merchant descriptor and authorization date/time 3. Submit: - duplicate receipt, or - lost receipt declaration plus card statement backup If you want, I can help you with either of these safe options: - a polished **lost receipt declaration PDF plan**, or - a **duplicate receipt request email** to the restaurant.
